title: The Title Fizz
shortDescription: A pop-inspired, pet-friendly seven-storey condominium of just 135 residences by Rhom Bho Property, in the Kata–Karon area of Phuket.
description:
The Title Fizz is a condominium by Rhom Bho Property, the developer behind The Title brand, in the Kata–Karon area on Phuket's west coast. It is a single seven-storey building with only 135 residences, which the developer presents as a more private, pet-friendly alternative to larger projects nearby.
The design concept is called "tropical pop": three ideas named Wave, Pop and Bubble bring sand-to-seafoam colours, curved façades and playful arches into the interiors. Residents share a communal pool and a private clubhouse building created for the 135 homes, and the developer advertises a complimentary shuttle to the beach.
Listings show one-bedroom homes of about 32 m², two-bedroom homes of about 58 m² and three-bedroom homes of about 105 m², with further one-bedroom Plus and penthouse types. Units are offered within the Thai foreign quota. The project is at pre-sale stage and the developer has not published a completion date, so ask us for the current price list, floor plans and availability.
